item.title: Small team, big heart: Santos, Tan represent NMI at 2026 World Cross Country Championships
item.description: TALLAHASSEE, Fl. (Press Release) — Northern Marianas Athletics is proud to have a small but determined team represent the CNMI at the 2026 World Athletics Cross Country Championships at Apalachee Regional Park in Tallahassee, Florida. The team included U20 runner Victor Nash Santos, Open Female 10K competitor Nathania “Tania” Tan, and coaches Dr. Ron Snyder and Kathryn Watt, who trains Tania in Hawaii. item.title: Tens of thousands protest in Minneapolis over fatal ICE shooting
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS (Reuters) — Tens of thousands of people marched through Minneapolis on Saturday to decry the fatal shooting of a woman by a U.S. immigration agent, part of more than 1,000 rallies planned nationwide this weekend against the federal government's deportation drive. item.description: CEBU CITY, Philippines (Reuters) — The death toll from a landfill collapse in the central Philippines has risen to four, an official said on Saturday, as rescue efforts continued for dozens who remained missing. item.title: The forgotten nuclear test victims in the Marshall Islands
item.description: MAJURO — Although evidence shows that the entire Marshall Islands was subjected to radioactive fallout from hydrogen bomb tests at Bikini Atoll in the 1950s, there are three specific populations who were exposed to relatively high levels of radiation by United States government actions from the 1950s to the 1970s — and for whom there has never been any type of medical monitoring or follow up. item.title: New law allows home-based food businesses
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang on Thursday signed into law Senate Bill 24-31, which aims to help struggling small businesses survive by allowing them to sell Non-Time/Temperature Control for Safety or on-TCS food prepared in residential kitchens. Authored by Senate Floor Leader Donald M. Manglona, S.B. 24-31 is now Public Law 24-22. The post New law allows home-based food businesses appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.
